candidates.metaphor: A calendar month where every future date is scribbled with a promise ring while today's cell stays empty — deferral made literal and instantly self-recognizable.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Left-column headline 'EVERY DAY YOU SAY TOMORROW' with TOMORROW in gold; small caption 'the day that never arrives' beneath.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Calendar slides in from right, rings draw sequentially across past dates (stagger), today's cell stays unhighlighted until a final subtleScale.
candidates.whyItWorks: The ruled grid plus repeated empty rings reads as habit without narration; gold marks the promise word as the semantic core of the beat.

candidates.metaphor: The single word TOMORROW repeated downward in diminishing opacity — each echo fainter, showing the promise losing force each time it is spoken.
candidates.typographyStrategy: WordReveal stack of TOMORROW ×4 fading from #F4F1EA to muted; top line carries the gold accent; one hairline rule separates yesterday's echo.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Words reveal top-to-bottom on a 0.18s stagger while each lower instance fades further; one subordinate glow behind the top word only.
candidates.whyItWorks: Typography itself becomes the object of decay — pure recognition, near-zero clutter, high text priority match.

candidates.metaphor: An unlit match held static beside a struck-through 'TODAY' — intention present, action withheld; the flame exists only as a dim teal ghost.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline 'YOU SAY TOMORROW' right-aligned, TOMORROW gold; caption 'held, never struck' in muted secondary.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Match stem draws in (draw entrance), a ghost flame pulses once with emphasis glow then dims — no actual ignition.
candidates.whyItWorks: Potential energy unspent is a visceral metaphor for deferred change; the negative space around the match carries the quiet emotion.

candidates.metaphor: A growing stack of identical promise cards, each labeled TOMORROW, piling up while one card waits untouched — repetition accumulating into weight.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Small counter 'DAY 001' with counterChange; one bold label 'TOMORROW' on the top card; headline compact at top-left.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Cards drop into the stack with staggered slide entrances; counter increments once at emphasisAt to imply the count is still rising.
candidates.whyItWorks: Physical accumulation converts an abstract habit into visible cost; the untouched card signals today's choice never made.

candidates.metaphor: A single large empty checkbox labeled TODAY beside a checked list of every other day — the one action that matters is the one left unticked.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline 'TOMORROW IS EASY' with TOMORROW gold, subheadline 'today stays unchecked' — two lines max, left aligned.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Timeline items check themselves in sequence (checkAt stagger) stopping abruptly at TODAY; arrow nudges toward it with positionShift.
candidates.whyItWorks: Checkbox incompleteness is a universal cognitive itch — self-recognition arrives before any critique, matching the beat's quiet tone.

candidates.metaphor: The word TOMORROW is crossed out — then the identical word reappears below, already crossed again. The strike never lands on a change, only on a repeat.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Two stacked oversized lines of TOMORROW, second one already struck; accent word 'SAME' in gold on a small label beneath.
candidates.motionOpportunity: First line strikes with draw; second line slides in unchanged with the strike pre-drawn, emphasis highlight at repeat.
candidates.whyItWorks: Uses the beat's own word as the object of failure — repetition made literally visible without narration.

candidates.metaphor: A ring of linked marks forms a closed loop — the path that should extend forward instead rejoins itself, an endless unbroken circuit.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Centered headline REPEAT / THE SAME THING with 'SAME' in gold; small label DAY 1 · DAY 2 · DAY ∞ at loop edge.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Link segments draw in sequence around the loop, then an arrow attempts to exit and dissolves back into the ring.
candidates.whyItWorks: The closed ring is a universal stagnation symbol; escape motion failing communicates the trap directly.

candidates.metaphor: Yesterday's ticked box appears again — same box, same tick, same day, showing the promise resolved into a ritual rather than a result.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Left-aligned headline SAME CHOICE / TOMORROW with 'SAME' in gold; caption 'the box gets checked. nothing gets changed.'
candidates.motionOpportunity: First checkbox checks with draw; second checkbox checks identically on delay with subtleScale emphasis, no state change between them.
candidates.whyItWorks: Checkbox completion normally signals progress; identical repetition subverts it into unease — progress that isn't progress.

candidates.metaphor: A month grid fills with the same highlighted cell pattern day after day — the marks differ in position but never in kind, a flat line of sameness.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Right headline EVERY DAY / THE SAME with accent 'SAME' in gold; label REPEAT on the grid side.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Cells activate in a stagger across two days producing identical patterns; progress bar fills then resets with counterChange.
candidates.whyItWorks: Calendar structure grounds the time dimension of the loop in a single glance, emphasizing duration of the pattern.

candidates.metaphor: A progress bar labelled TOMORROW advances with effort, then snaps back to zero — each advance indistinguishable from the last, forward motion that never accumulates.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline PROMISE / RESET with 'RESET' in red; subheadline 'tomorrow looks exactly like today.'
candidates.motionOpportunity: Bar fills with counterChange, then snaps back and refills identically; arrow slides forward and returns to origin.
candidates.whyItWorks: The reset reads instantly as self-reinforcing failure — motion without accumulation is stagnation itself.

candidates.metaphor: Two small figures on opposite cliff edges with a measured void between them turns emotional distance into a literal, crossable gap.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Left-anchored headline; accent only on 'WANT TO BE' to mark the desired self across the void.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Figures slide in from opposite edges, then a thin measure line draws across the chasm, emphasizing span over drop.
candidates.whyItWorks: Concrete, instantly readable without narration; the drawing line makes distance feel measurable and finite rather than hopeless.

candidates.metaphor: Two facing profile forms made of simple arcs, separated by a column of empty space, make identity contrast a geometry problem.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Typography sits inside the negative space between forms; words stack down the gap so copy IS the distance.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Arcs fade in from each edge, then WordReveal staggers the phrase down the gap, physically filling void with intent.
candidates.whyItWorks: Elegant and symbolic rather than illustrative; uses negative space as the primary storytelling element.

candidates.metaphor: A bridge whose span is only two anchor lines with missing planks shows the way exists but the crossing is unbuilt.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline top-third; the emphasis phrase rendered in gold as the far-side landing point of the bridge.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Anchor lines draw from each side, planks stagger in partially and stop, leaving visible holes at center.
candidates.whyItWorks: Communicates that the path is knowable yet unfinished, which motivates the later 'tiny choices' payoff.

candidates.metaphor: A BeforeAfter diagram frames current self versus desired self as two labeled columns with an empty measurable span between them.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline left, accent on 'GAP'; a numeric span label quantifies distance like a stat card.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Columns reveal in stagger, then the distance bar counts up its value, turning longing into data.
candidates.whyItWorks: Makes the abstract emotional pain concrete and quantifiable, matching the beat's abstract meaning precisely.

candidates.metaphor: The headline itself is torn in half with a dark vertical void between 'WHO YOU ARE' and 'WHO YOU WANT TO BE', letting typography embody the chasm.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Two stacked uppercase blocks, second block in gold; the gap between them is the visual subject.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Halves slide apart on entrance, then a single hairline draws across the void as the only bridge suggested.
candidates.whyItWorks: Purest typography-priority option; meaning survives even at small scale because the layout is the metaphor.

candidates.metaphor: A bridge over a dark void lays its own planks one at a time — each plank a small decision, cumulative construction visible mid-assembly.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline 'BUILT FROM TINY CHOICES' upper-left, 'TINY CHOICES' gold-accented, one word per line constraint respected.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Tiles stagger-in left to right (stagger entrance), each landing with subtleScale emphasis; void glow stays subordinate.
candidates.whyItWorks: Direct literalization of 'built' — the assembling bridge reads instantly without narration and promises removability.

candidates.metaphor: A chain extends link by link across the frame; the newest link is still glowing, showing each choice adds material to what holds you back.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline left, max 3 lines, accent 'CHOICES' in gold; small label 'ONE LINK = ONE DECISION' as caption.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Links reveal sequentially via draw-like scale entrances, final link highlight emphasis at beat midpoint.
candidates.whyItWorks: Chain implies both construction and constraint — the gap is made of linked choices, hence detachable.

candidates.metaphor: Each small choice drops as a step, forming a staircase descending into the gap — accumulation made spatial, the descent repeated daily.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline top-center uppercase; 'TINY CHOICES' gold, subheadline 'ONE STEP AT A TIME' muted below.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Stack bars drop in from top with slide entrance, one per 0.15s; arrow draws downward afterward.
candidates.whyItWorks: Vertical accumulation maps time to space; stairs read as both progress and repetition.

candidates.metaphor: A grid of cells fills one square at a time, forming the shape of the gap — the picture exists only because of accumulated small fills.
candidates.typographyStrategy: WordReveal headline right-aligned; accent on 'TINY' only; caption 'EVERY CELL A CHOICE' beneath.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Cells stagger-fill sequentially; one cell pulses subtleScale as the latest choice.
candidates.whyItWorks: Granular grid makes 'tiny' tangible; partial fill shows construction in progress, high negative space preserved.

candidates.metaphor: A horizontal timeline accrues one tick per day — small marks sum into a long bar that spans the gap between two profile silhouettes.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline left 'BUILT FROM TINY CHOICES' with gold 'CHOICES'; timeline labels minimal day numbers.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Ticks draw in sequence via stagger; the accumulated bar extends with controlledReveal to touch the second profile.
candidates.whyItWorks: Connects micro-choices to identity gap explicitly, setting up the 'unmade' reframe of the script.

candidates.metaphor: A hand-built balance beam tilts toward a tiny gold weight that overpowers a large dim mass: value, not volume, decides. Reads instantly as 'what you want most outweighs what you want now'.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline 96px uppercase, 2 lines, accent word 'MOST' in gold; beam sits below in negative space as proof.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Beam enters with slide, then one controlled positionShift settling the gold side down; gold pan gets a single subtleScale emphasis at 60%.
candidates.whyItWorks: It turns preference ordering into physics — the viewer feels the verdict before reading the sentence, and the gold accent carries full semantic weight.

candidates.metaphor: Two equal doorways side by side: the left one lit with flat ordinary light (comfortable now), the right one edged in gold (what you want most). Choice is spatial — you simply walk toward one.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline top-left 88px with 'MOST' gold; two tiny labels 'NOW' muted and 'LATER' gold under each doorway card.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Cards enter staggered, then arrow draws toward the gold card with emphasis highlight while the muted card stays static at 0.6 opacity.
candidates.whyItWorks: Doors make the beat feel like a real daily decision rather than an abstraction, and the asymmetry of attention shows the ranking visually.

candidates.metaphor: A numbered priority list where the long-term want is checked first and the immediate urge sits unchecked below — discipline is literally reordering the list and ticking the top item.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline left, 3 lines max, 'MOST' gold and 'NOW' muted; right column carries the numbered sequence with one checked item.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Sequence items reveal with stagger, Checkbox checkAt fires mid-scene as the only emphasis, plus a highlight sweep on the checked row.
candidates.whyItWorks: Ranking plus a tick makes the abstract idea of preference ordering concrete, procedural and repeatable — conviction through order, not drama.

candidates.metaphor: The sentence itself becomes the scale: 'MOST' rendered heavy in gold and dense, 'NOW' rendered thin and dim — typography weight performs the meaning without any literal object.
candidates.typographyStrategy: WordReveal 100px uppercase across 3 lines, accent words ['MOST','NOW'] but only MOST in gold while NOW stays muted gray; single low glow behind the gold word.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Word-by-word stagger with 0.12s steps, then a subtleScale on 'MOST' (delta 0.06) and a glow emphasis at 70% as the beat lands.
candidates.whyItWorks: Highest visual-priority beat, highest typography-priority beat — letting type carry the metaphor gives maximum clarity with minimum clutter.

candidates.concept: THE FORK: GOLD ROAD vs DIM ROAD
candidates.metaphor: A single trunk path splits into two branches — the immediate branch fading into dim gray, the enduring branch continuing in gold. Discipline is the moment of taking the harder fork today.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline top-left 92px uppercase, 'MOST' gold; small caption 'TINY CHOICE, EVERY DAY' muted under the fork node.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Trunk draws first, branches reveal staggered, active gold branch extends with controlledReveal while dim branch holds, ending on a single Indicator pulse.
candidates.whyItWorks: It links this beat to the script's larger 'tiny choices build the gap' idea, giving one decisive image that means choice, direction and conviction at once.

candidates.metaphor: A grid of empty dormant days is broken by one cell filling with accent light — the smallest possible commitment made visible as the first mark on an otherwise untouched calendar.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline "START TODAY. START SMALL." with "TODAY" and "SMALL" as the two accent words; short caption below.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Grid fades in dormant, then a single cell counter-changes to accent with a controlledReveal pulse, echoing the two-line headline with stagger.
candidates.whyItWorks: Turns both objections into one image: an empty grid = nothing done yet, one lit cell = trivially small and happening now.

candidates.metaphor: One small point of teal light in an otherwise black frame — near-zero entry cost rendered as a single spark that doesn't need to be a fire to be real.
candidates.typographyStrategy: WordReveal headline centered, "START" accented; tiny caption "TODAY. SMALL." beneath the spark.
candidates.motionOpportunity: WordReveal staggers the headline, then the dot scales from 0 with a single subordinate glow bloom as the emphasis beat.
candidates.whyItWorks: Emotionally encouraging and radically simple; darkness makes the smallness feel brave rather than inadequate.

candidates.metaphor: A single footprint-like chevron mark lands at the base of a long path line — the journey ahead is huge, but only the first small mark is required now.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Left-aligned headline with "TODAY" accented, badge "STEP 01" in gold as the scale-objection reducer.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Path line draws in, then the first chevron marks in with a draw entrance while the badge highlights after.
candidates.whyItWorks: Converts 'start' into literal forward motion; 'STEP 01' visually proves the scale is small.

candidates.metaphor: A small coin-sized Circle sits on one side of a balance Line against a heavy empty mass — the tiny act is small in size but already tipping the scale toward change.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline top-left, "SMALL" accented teal; a single subline: "TODAY IS ENOUGH."
candidates.motionOpportunity: Balance line settles with positionShift as the small circle lands with a scale entrance, emphasizing the tipping moment.
candidates.whyItWorks: Speaks to the 'too small to matter' doubt by showing small acts already carrying decisive weight.

candidates.metaphor: A single stationary point accelerates into a horizontal stroke cutting across the void — the hesitation held as a dot, the decision visible as extension. Progress reads instantly without narration.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline 'BUT START.' at 128px uppercase, 'START' in teal accent; one caption line below the extending stroke.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Dot holds 0.4s, then draws into a line that streaks right while the headline stamps in with scale entrance; glow rises behind the line origin.
candidates.whyItWorks: Directly literalizes the beat's own metaphorHint (dot becoming a line) while the horizontal thrust gives the imperative forward velocity.

candidates.metaphor: One small flame ignites from a struck point, pushing back a large field of near-black. The tiny light outweighing vast darkness says beginning dissolves the gap.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline 'BUT START.' stacked bottom-left, 'START' gold-accented; short caption 'the only move left' in secondary text.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Match head flares with emphasis glow (single permitted glow), flame settles to steady, headline reveals word-staggered from the light outward.
candidates.whyItWorks: Emotional shift urgency→resolve is embodied as cold dark giving way to one warm point — high contrast, minimal elements.

candidates.metaphor: A figure's edge is a hard horizontal line; a second short line extends past it into empty space. The gap is literally bridged by a single stroke that starts before it's certain.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Left-aligned headline 'BUT START.' with 'START' in teal, subheadline 'the gap closes when you move' at 40px.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Bridge line draws out past the edge (draw entrance), arrow slides after it, headline slides in from left with positionShift emphasis.
candidates.whyItWorks: Turns the abstract 'gap' into spatial geometry the eye crosses in one motion — tension at the edge, release in the extension.

candidates.concept: COUNTER OF ZERO RESETS TO ONE
candidates.metaphor: Every prior promise sits at zero; the counter flips to 1 the instant action begins. A single unit of motion outweighs endless accumulated intention.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Counter 0→1 as dominant element at 200px teal, headline 'BUT START.' directly beneath, caption 'small counts' muted below.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Counter counterChange from 0 to 1 on beat, progress bar fills a first sliver, badge 'DAY 1' fades in — three tight staggered animations.
candidates.whyItWorks: Contrasts the script's repetition of empty tomorrows with the irreplaceable first increment; numeric finality matches urgency→resolve.

candidates.metaphor: A lone vertical line punches down through a horizontal barrier, its tip breaking into open space below — effort concentrated in one point beats the whole surface.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline anchored bottom at 112px, 'START' gold; a single label 'now' sits at the penetration point.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Line draws downward through the barrier with masked reveal, impact pulse glow at break point, headline rises with slide entrance.
candidates.whyItWorks: Gives the imperative physical weight — one concentrated beginning defeats a wide obstacle; gold marks the decisive moment.
